semantic_description: Independent Semantic runs (model review), apart from Quality: plan, run, status, cancel, history and methods. They need no Quality run.
semantic_option_quality: Attach a Quality report as evidence: its run ID or latest. Its freshness against the current source is checked and disclosed; a stale report is never a current approval.
semantic_option_events_jsonl: Also write the events of the run (JSON Lines) to this file.
semantic_option_run_id: Use this Semantic run ID (sem_...) instead of a new one (the local server uses it).
semantic_option_limit: Maximum number of runs in the history (default 20).
semantic_option_no_interactive: Never ask anything (the command does not ask today; accepted for scripts).
semantic_missing_subcommand_fix: Use jgates semantic plan, run, status <id>, cancel <id>, history or methods.
semantic_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use jgates semantic plan, run, status <id>, cancel <id>, history or methods.
semantic_unexpected_argument_fix: Remove the extra argument; see jgates semantic --help.
semantic_bad_cwd: The folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
semantic_bad_limit_fix: Use a whole number greater than zero.
semantic_bad_events_path: The folder of the events file does not exist: {path}
semantic_bad_events_path_fix: Create the folder first or choose another file for --events-jsonl.
semantic_missing_run_fix: Pass the ID shown by jgates semantic history (sem_...).
semantic_bad_run_id_fix: Semantic run IDs start with sem_; Quality runs (run_...) are in jgates history.
semantic_run_not_found: No Semantic run {runId} in this workspace.
semantic_run_not_found_fix: List the Semantic runs with jgates semantic history.
semantic_run_not_active: The Semantic run {runId} already finished; there is nothing to cancel.
semantic_run_not_active_fix: Open it with jgates semantic status {runId}.
semantic_not_ready_fix: Run jgates semantic plan to see what is missing; configure the provider in jgates.yml > extensions.semantic-gate (or jgates providers).
semantic_blocker_not_configured: No provider is configured (jgates.yml > extensions.semantic-gate.provider); a Semantic run needs one.
semantic_blocker_package: The semantic-gate package is not built (semantic-gate/dist).
semantic_blocker_too_many_methods: {count} methods were selected; at most {max} can be selected at once.
semantic_option_method: Run these Semantic methods (comma-separated IDs, in order; each one becomes its own Semantic run). See jgates semantic methods. asvs-review (ASVS review) is an AI review of the source against the ASVS requirements no deterministic check examined; it needs a finished Quality run and shows its cost before it starts.
semantic_bad_method_fix: List the methods with jgates semantic methods and pass their IDs separated by commas.
semantic_text_sequence_stopped: The remaining methods were not started: {reason}
semantic_prereq_quality_none: Not required: a Semantic run does not need a Quality run.
semantic_quality_same_source: The Quality run {runId} judged this same source: its report is current.
semantic_quality_different_source: The Quality run {runId} judged another source (the files changed since): its report is stale and is not a current approval.
semantic_quality_source_untraceable: The source identity of the Quality run {runId} or of the current folder does not cover every file: freshness is unknown and the report is not a current approval.
semantic_quality_source_legacy: The Quality run {runId} did not record a complete source identity: freshness is unknown and the report is not a current approval.
semantic_quality_unreadable: The result of the Quality run {runId} cannot be read: it is not evidence.
semantic_reason_budget: The call budget ends before the review; nothing was sent.
semantic_reason_not_run_context: Not run: the review context was not ready.
semantic_reason_interrupted: The process of the run stopped before it finished; settled as cancelled.
semantic_summary_passed: Semantic review approved (score {score}). Advisory: it binds nothing outside this run.
semantic_summary_failed: Semantic review did not approve ({status}, {count} blocking).
semantic_summary_invalid: The model output is not valid; nothing is approved: {reason}
semantic_summary_cancelled: Semantic run cancelled; the partial evidence was kept.
semantic_summary_incomplete: Semantic run incomplete ({state}); nothing is approved.
semantic_history_empty: No Semantic runs yet in this workspace.
semantic_cancel_requested: Cancel requested for {runId}; the run stops its own processes and keeps its partial evidence.
semantic_cancel_settled: The process of {runId} was gone; the run is now settled as cancelled.
semantic_text_ready: Ready to run: jgates semantic run
semantic_text_not_ready: Not ready: fix the items marked -- above.
semantic_text_cancelling: Cancelling: stopping the processes of this run...
semantic_api_semantic_run_active: A Semantic run started here is still going: {runId}.
semantic_api_semantic_run_active_fix: Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
semantic_api_semantic_not_ready_fix: Configure the provider of the semantic gate first.
semantic_api_run_not_found: No Semantic run {runId} in this workspace.
semantic_api_run_not_active: The Semantic run {runId} already finished; there is nothing to cancel.
semantic_api_semantic_policy_mode: A CI policy folder is being edited: it is not a project, so there is nothing to review.
semantic_api_semantic_policy_mode_fix: Open the project with jgates ui to run a Semantic review.
semantic_reproduction_reason_REPRODUCER_: the reproducer passed, so the defect was not shown
the reproducer did not run to a verdict (it did not load or declared no test)
semantic_reproduction_reason_DEPENDENCIE: a package the reproducer needs is not prepared (jgates deps prepare)
semantic_reproduction_reason_ATTRIBUTED_: the reproducer failed because of the test itself, not the defect
the reproducer failed because of the environment, not the defect
semantic_reproduction_reason_ATTRIBUTION: the reproducer failed, but the failure could not be attributed to the defect
semantic_reproduction_reason_BUDGET: the budget of the run ended before it
semantic_reproduction_reason_REPRODUCER_: the reproducer was refused by the host checks
semantic_reproduction_never_rejects: A failed reproduction never rejects a finding and never lowers its severity.
semantic_reproduction_cost: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}, up to {calls, plural, one {# model call} other {# model calls}}; the project's tests run in a container without network.
semantic_option_from: With --method confirm-by-reproduction: the earlier Semantic run (sem_...) whose needs-validation findings it tries to reproduce (absent: the newest run that has one).
semantic_option_finding: With --from: reproduce only this finding of that run (its ID, such as C1).
semantic_reproduction_option_without_met: Add --method confirm-by-reproduction, or leave out --from and --finding.
semantic_reproduction_finding_without_fr: --finding names a finding of one earlier run: --from is missing.
Name the earlier run with --from <sem_...> (see jgates semantic history).
semantic_reproduction_bad_from_fix: Pass the ID of an earlier Semantic run of this workspace (see jgates semantic history).
semantic_reproduction_bad_finding_fix: Pass one finding ID of that run, such as C1 (see jgates semantic status <run>).
semantic_blocker_reproduction_bad_select: The earlier run or finding to reproduce is not valid: {value}
semantic_blocker_reproduction_without_me: An earlier run to reproduce was named, but {method} is not among the methods.
semantic_blocker_asvs_review_no_quality_: {method} reviews what no deterministic check examined, and there is no finished validation of this workspace yet: validate the project first.
semantic_blocker_asvs_review_nothing_to_: {method} has nothing to review: every requirement of the project's ASVS level whose evidence is the repository was examined by a deterministic check or recorded as not applicable.
semantic_blocker_asvs_review_map_unavail: {method} cannot read the ASVS coverage map: {detail}
semantic_blocker_asvs_review_check_faile: {method} could not establish which requirements to review: {detail}
semantic_text_asvs_review_plan: ASVS review: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} of ASVS {version} level {level} that no deterministic check examined in {qualityRun}, in {units, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}}; up to {calls, plural, one {# model call} other {# model calls}}.
semantic_asvs_review_apart: The answers are an AI review of the source: the ASVS map shows them apart from the deterministic checks, and its findings need validation.
semantic_history_reproduction: {confirmed, plural, one {# confirmed by execution} other {# confirmed by execution}}, {attempted, plural, one {# reproduction attempted} other {# reproductions attempted}}
